findings.title: Feature-flagged table widget path renders an empty table
findings.body: When organization.features includes 'use-table-widget-visualization', tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with hard-coded empty columns and tableData instead of the already-available fields, result.meta, and result.data (and the existing custom field renderers/header map). Any organization with this flag enabled gets blank dashboard table widgets regardless of the query results, so the flag cannot be safely enabled until this is wired to the real result.

findings.title: Timestamp/age validation uses truthiness and never requires either field
findings.body: Both age and timestamp are declared optional, and the mutual-exclusion checks use if self.initial_data.get("age") and if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). If both are present with value 0, which is a valid timestamp under min_value=0, both checks are skipped and the report is accepted. Additionally, a report with neither field is accepted because no validate() enforces that one of age or timestamp is present. This allows malformed reports to be ingested and counted, and the existing tests only cover age=1 while timestamp is present.

findings.title: Error IDs are paired with nodestore values by position
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids), then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). If get_multi omits missing nodes or returns values in a different order, the list is shifted and an error ID can be paired with another error's title/message, so the AI summary is built from incorrect error context. Look each node_id up in the returned mapping, for example events.get(node_id), instead of relying on positional alignment.
